data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Horrible Experience](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a5e56b4a2efce5ece78896f)
Absolutely, horrible service. I can’t find anyone to talk to over the phone. Having a heck of a time returning a rug we purchased. When we purchased the rug, your website indicated that the item qualified for free and easy returns. Now you’re telling me that I bear the cost of shipping both ways which is close to $800. I would have given you zero stars, but you have to include at least one to write a review.

July 7, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 21, 2026

Hi Robert,

Thank you for your feedback! We sincerely apologize for the delay in our response. The free return on this rug means you won't be charged a restocking fee, but please note that the shipping cost is non-refundable. We can arrange a pickup for the rug without the packaging. Please provide us with the return information requested by our Customer support team at your earliest convenience, so we can proceed with your return order. Thank you for your patience, and we are happy to help!

Lulu and Georgia
